notes.title: 🌍 LOCALIZATION UPDATE – The Wallway now speaks your language! 🗣️

notes.title: OPTIMIZATION & FIXES
notes.content:
[h1]🎯 OPTIMIZATION & FIXES – Beta 1.0.7 Update[/h1][h2]🛠️ Performance Boosts, Bug Fixes & Visual Refinements![/h2]
Our journey through Early Access continues! With [b]Beta 1.0.7[/b], we focused on [b]stability, performance[/b], and making the game [b]feel smoother and better than ever[/b].

Your feedback has been invaluable, and this update is packed with much-needed polishing.
[list]  [*]⚙️ [b]Optimizations[/b] to improve FPS and reduce lag[/*]  [*]🔧 [b]System tuning[/b] for multiplayer and core gameplay mechanics[/*]  [*]🎨 [b]Design improvements[/b] across maps and UI[/*]  [*]🐛 [b]Bug fixes[/b] based on player reports[/*][/list]
We’re steadily improving the experience and laying the foundation for upcoming content and features. Thank you for being part of this beta journey!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 – Map & Mechanics Overhaul
notes.content:
This update brings several gameplay and atmosphere improvements to The Wallway, focusing on player interaction, map clarity, and new gameplay elements.

[b]🗺️ Map Adjustments[/b] – Updated layout and environmental tweaks for smoother navigation.
[b]🖐️ Object Interaction Tweaks[/b] – More responsive and intuitive object handling.
[b]🌫️ Reduced Visual Effects[/b] – Lowered some visual effects for better clarity and performance.
[b]⚙️ Object System Tuning[/b] – Optimized behaviors and interactions of specific objects.
[b]🔊 New Sound Effects[/b] – Added immersive sound cues to enhance tension and realism.
[b]☠️ Skeleton Kill System[/b] – You can now eliminate skeletons under certain conditions.
[b]🏆 New Achievement[/b] – “And he’s gone...” has been added. Can you unlock it?

More content and improvements are on the way — thank you for playing The Wallway!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 – Design & Network Fixes
notes.content:
This patch brings a mix of design improvements and better network performance to enhance your co-op horror experience in The Wallway.

[b]🌐 Network Transmission Tuning[/b] – Improved data transfer between clients for smoother sessions.
[b]🔧 Minor Adjustments[/b] – Small internal changes to support stability and performance.

Thank you for your support – more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1: Hit & Chase Fix
notes.content:
This minor update brings important improvements to both the monster’s behavior and the multiplayer experience.

What’s included:

💀 [b]Monster Hit Fix[/b] – Resolved an issue where the monster's attack didn't register properly in certain cases.
🛠️ [b]Multiplayer Tuning[/b] – Improved overall stability and synchronization in online sessions.
💀 [b]Monster Chase Fix[/b] – Adjusted monster AI to better handle chase logic and target switching.

Thanks for playing The Wallway — more updates are on the way!
